paper: HedgeAgents: A Balanced-aware Multi-agent Financial Trading System
headline_strategy: Four-agent cross-asset hedge-fund system: specialist agents Dave, Bob, and Emily trade crypto, DJ30 stocks, and FX, while manager Otto runs a 30-day budget-allocation conference using expected return, covariance risk, and CVaR, coordinates experience sharing, and triggers an extreme-market conference

paper_configuration.extreme_trigger: daily amplitude >5% or cumulative three-day amplitude >10%

paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable because only a static project site and screenshots are released, with no agent, tool, memory, allocation, order, or portfolio implementation
missing_headline_objects: HedgeAgents code, runtime environment, agent/profile serialization, tool implementations, and runner
exact DJ30/FX/crypto universe and constituent vintage plus frozen Yahoo/Alpaca inputs
the 60 indicators, full prompts, model/embedding snapshots, memory database, seeds and repeated-run policy
budget-allocation lambdas, CVaR alpha, covariance window, solver, constraints and failure handling
experience-sharing cadence/rounds and extreme-market definition/execution logic
initial capital, sizing, fill timing, cash, short/leverage, costs and slippage
native actions, orders, fills, holdings, cash ledger, NAV/return paths and plot arrays

rejected_substitutes.reason: Its lambdas, alpha, covariance estimator, solver and bounds are absent and the equation itself has unresolved symbols and CVaR limits.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use Bob's profile screenshot as a stock policy
rejected_substitutes.reason: Tool/action names do not define tool outputs, prompts, memory, decision logic, quantities, or execution.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the local balanced-risk or CVaR thematic proxy
rejected_substitutes.reason: A generic allocation heuristic contains none of the specialist decisions, conferences, experience sharing, or extreme-market mechanism.

rejected_substitutes.route: Infer a return path from author tables or curve images
rejected_substitutes.reason: Static values and plots do not identify dated holdings, trades, fills or exact returns; the full-system MDD also conflicts across paper tables.

rejected_substitutes.route: Run a current model on JKP characteristics
rejected_substitutes.reason: The historical model is unavailable and JKP does not replace the news, tools, memories, cross-asset agents and conferences defining the policy.

result_policy: No incomplete risk equation, screenshot profile, thematic allocator, plot reconstruction, or invented JKP agent is entered as a HedgeAgents return. The positive paper results remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
